title: Clean before and after: Home cleaning after moving in
prompt:
A vertical 9:16 before-and-after ad (the result first) for a local service business in Rwanda. Setting: a home in Kigali. Light: bright daylight. Music: upbeat, satisfying beat.
0-3s: Wide shot, locked-off static camera: the result first: a spotless, shining room in a home in Kigali. Sound: a bright chime.
3-5s: Wide shot, static camera: the same spot before: dusty and untidy.
5-8s: Medium shot, waist up, tracking shot following the subject: a fictional adult worker in a uniform, seen from behind, works quickly with the Home cleaning after moving in.
8-10s: Clean hero shot, subject centred, slow push-in: on the clean, shining result. A warm voice-over says in English: "Book your spot at Urugo Homes."
No on-screen text or added logos.
notes: No product photo: Seedance will imagine the Home cleaning after moving in from the words. Add a photo as Image 1 so it looks exactly like yours.
